   ```

   ```

5. 检查 /tmp 磁盘空间（handoff 提到 /tmp 磁盘问题）：
   ```
   df -h /tmp
   ```

      Two parts:
      (A) Measurement error model (PRIMARY): extend Stan model to treat exposure
      as noisy observation: exposure_ij ~ N(τ_ij, σ_e²), where τ is latent true
      contamination. σ_e estimated from exp-001 ground truth FP/FN rates.
      This propagates Stage 1 uncertainty into posteriors automatically.
      Compare coverage (50%/80%/95%) vs point-estimate exposure baseline.
      (B) Post-hoc noise injection: inject Gaussian noise at 1×/1.5×/2× matched
      levels, re-fit standard model, measure CI widening for γ and θ.
      Both parts inform whether measurement error model closes the coverage gap.
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 0
    deps: [exp-002, exp-004]
    note: CPU only
    registry_id: exp_005_noise_prop_v2
    # Related: exp_005_noise_prop (v1, DONE/failed — sigma_e=0 bug)

  - id: exp-006
    name: irt_calibration_and_baselines
    claim: 1
    also_supports: [3]
    description: >
      Fit 4PL+γ IRT (Stan NUTS) on controlled models from exp-001/003.
      PRIMARY: per-benchmark fitting with benchmark-specific γ_k — this is
      the natural parameterization when IRT is fitted per-benchmark (each
      benchmark's model has its own γ_k). ABLATION: joint fitting across
      benchmarks with shared global γ (stronger assumption, tests whether
      contamination effect is homogeneous across benchmarks). Report both.
      Per-benchmark fitting (not joint) is the default to reduce local
      independence violation scope. Posterior predictive checks on item-level residual
      correlations to assess local independence empirically.
      Compute calibrated scores via exposure=0 counterfactual with CIs.
      Compare against 7 baselines:
      (0) Raw — no adjustment (anchor),
      (1) remove-and-rescore (drop flagged items),
      (2) single-signal 2PL+γ (best signal only, simpler IRT),
      (3) vanilla 4PL without γ (standard IRT, no contamination modeling),
      (4) linear exposure regression + bootstrap CI (simplest post-hoc),
      (5) Emperor's mitigation: rephrasing + option shuffling,
      (6) DCR fuzzy inference (EMNLP 2025) — the only existing method
          producing adjusted accuracy; must include or reviewers will reject.
      Evaluate all 5 metrics: MAE, coverage (50%/80%/95%), sharpness,
      Kendall τ, dose-response monotonicity.
      Report mean ± std across 3 seeds (matched to exp-001 seeds).
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 8
    deps: [exp-003]
    benchmarks: [MMLU, GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, HumanEval]
    seeds: 3

  # ============================================================
  # P1: Important — run if time/GPU permit
  # ============================================================

  - id: exp-015
    name: sft_d100_qc_only
    claim: 1
    description: >
      100% dosage SFT using only QC-pass paraphrases (7547/16697 items).
      Isolates noisy vs clean contamination confound identified by reviewer.
      D012 decision. Compare calibration metrics against exp-001 d100 (all
      paraphrases) to quantify effect of noisy contamination on IRT estimates.
    priority: P1
    gpu_budget_hours: 5
    deps: [exp-001]
    benchmarks: [MMLU, GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, HumanEval]
    models: [Qwen2.5-0.5B]
    seeds: 1
    status: planned
    registry_id: exp_001_sft_d100_qc_only
    data_script: exp001/prepare_qc_only_data.py

  - id: exp-007
    name: scale_bridging_7b
    claim: 1
    description: >
      Qwen2.5-7B controlled SFT injection at 5 dosage levels.
      Validates calibration accuracy scales to larger models.
      Requires multi-GPU node (7B LoRA SFT ~4-8h per run on 1×H100).
    priority: P1
    gpu_budget_hours: 30
    deps: [exp-001]

  - id: exp-008
    name: signal_survival_analysis
    claim: 2
    description: >
      Systematic evaluation of detection signal reliability across training regimes.
      Signal × regime AUC heatmap: 4 signals × {base, SFT-clean, SFT-contaminated,
      RL-post-trained}. Confirms Self-Critique compensates where Min-K%++/ConStat
      degrade post-RL (per fragility paper arXiv 2510.02386).
      ELEVATED to Core Contribution 2 per Dream review (all 3 tiers identified
      this as the most genuinely novel finding).
    priority: P0
    gpu_budget_hours: 10
    deps: [exp-002]

  - id: exp-014
    name: multi_family_validation
    claim: 1
    description: >
      Controlled SFT injection on at least one non-Qwen model family
      (Llama-3.2-1B or Pythia-1.4B) at 3 dosage levels (0%, 25%, 100%).
      Validates that identifiability boundaries and calibration accuracy
      generalize beyond Qwen2.5. Addresses Dream reviewer concern about
      single model family limiting generalizability (flagged [M][W]).
    priority: P1
    gpu_budget_hours: 15
    deps: [exp-001]

  - id: exp-009
    name: rl_observational_case_study
    claim: 2
    also_supports: [3]
    description: >
      Apply Self-Critique + available signals to existing RL-trained models:
      Qwen2.5-Instruct (0.5B/1.5B/3B/7B), DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B/7B.
      Fit IRT with appropriately wider CIs. Expected regret quantification:
      compare uncalibrated vs calibrated vs remove-rescore for top-5 model
      selection. Framed as observational — directional external validity,
      not full quantitative validation. Near-zero γ check on known-clean
      benchmark (specificity test).
    priority: P1
    gpu_budget_hours: 15
    deps: [exp-006, exp-008]

  # exp-010 (prior_sensitivity) and exp-011 (few_examinee_regime) merged into exp-004.
  # Prior × N_models dimensions already covered in the sweep grid.

  # ============================================================
  # P2: Bonus — adds breadth if resources allow
  # ============================================================

  - id: exp-012
    name: observational_72b
    claim: 1
    description: >
      Qwen2.5-72B observational analysis (inference only, no SFT).
      Extends ecological validity to frontier model scale.
    priority: P2
    gpu_budget_hours: 15
    deps: [exp-006]

  - id: exp-013
    name: closed_weight_2signal_mode
    claim: 2
    description: >
      Degraded 2-signal mode (ConStat + Self-Critique, no logits/embeddings)
      for closed-weight models. Ablation quantifying 2-signal vs 4-signal
      calibration accuracy gap.
    priority: P2
    gpu_budget_hours: 5
    deps: [exp-003]

# GPU Budget Summary
# ============================================================

  P0_hours: 90
  P1_hours: 60
  P2_hours: 20
  buffer_hours: 30
  total_hours: 200
  note: >
    CPU-only experiments (exp-004, exp-005, exp-011) excluded.
    Buffer covers reruns, debugging, multi-seed overhead, and unexpected issues.
    Requires 2-4× H100/A100-80G for parallel SFT runs.

    - With 2× H100: P0 in ~7 days, P1 in ~4 days, tight but feasible if parallelized

content.thinking:
Now I have the full picture for exp_005_v2. The log shows:
1. ME model ran for σ_e=0.1, seed=42: took 5713s (~95 min), CI_width=0.1017, Rhat=1.945 (bad convergence)
2. Simple model for σ_e=0.1, seed=42: all 4 chains returned retcode=1 (failure)
3. The output files were being written to `/tmp/tmpjxthbs72/` — a tmpfs directory

From the registry failure_reason: `/tmp tmpfs 磁盘配额耗尽。

So what happened is the ME model's 95-minute run generated roughly 1GB of CSV output across 9000 tau and 9000 log_lik samples for 4 chains, which exhausted the 3.9GB tmpfs space. When the Simple model then tried to write its CSV files, it hit the disk quota exceeded error, causing all 4 chains to fail with retcode=1.

After applying the Stan bug fixes between 20:47 and 20:48, v2 ran until 22:44 but still failed—this time not from Stan issues but from the same tmpfs quota problem. The ME model did converge partially (Rhat=1.945 indicating severe non-convergence due to being under-identified with 10231 parameters against only 9000 observations), while the Simple model couldn't even write its output before hitting the disk limit again.

Let me check on exp_004, which has been running for over 10 hours now—I need to see what's happening in its logs and whether it's actually making progress or stuck.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
exp-004: Simulation Identifiability Sweep for 4PL+γ IRT.
Systematically sweep AUC × N_models × prior × exposure_type to map recovery boundaries.

Usage:
    python run_sweep.py subset    # 12 conditions × 10 seeds = 120 runs
    python run_sweep.py full      # 144 conditions × 10 seeds = 1440 runs
    python run_sweep.py dry-run   # 1 condition × 1 seed for format check
"""

import json
import os
import sys
import time
import itertools
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm, rankdata
from scipy.special import expit
from pathlib import Path
import cmdstanpy

N_ITEMS = 300
GAMMA_TRUE = 0.5
BASE_EXPOSURE_RATE = 0.3
N_SEEDS = 10

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
STAN_FILE = str(SCRIPT_DIR / "contam_irt_4pl_sweep.stan")
RESULTS_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR / "results"

SUBSET = {
    "auc": [0.55, 0.65, 0.80, 0.90],
    "n_models": [20, 50, 100],
    "gamma_prior_sd": [1.0],
    "exposure_type": ["binary"],
}

FULL = {
    "auc": [0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90],
    "n_models": [20, 50, 100, 200],
    "gamma_prior_sd": [0.5, 1.0, 2.0],
    "exposure_type": ["binary", "continuous"],
}


def compute_auc(y_true, y_score):
    """AUC via Mann-Whitney U / Wilcoxon rank-sum."""
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).ravel()
    y_score = np.asarray(y_score).ravel()
    n_pos = int(np.sum(y_true == 1))
    n_neg = int(np.sum(y_true == 0))
    if n_pos == 0 or n_neg == 0:
        return 0.5
    ranks = rankdata(y_score)

## Phase 3 GPU 调度优先级 (Director 2026-05-14)
**原则：每个 model size 先跑两端极值 (d005, d100)，再填 d025/d050。**
优先级从高到低：
1. 1.5B d005 + d100 — GPU 0/5 完成 0.5B SFT 后立即接上
2. 3B d005 + d100 — 等有 GPU 空出
3. 0.5B d025 + d050 — eval GPU (1/2/4) 完成后可用
4. 1.5B d025 + d050 — 填充 dose-response 曲线
5. 3B d025 + d050 — 最后填充

**免审批：** GPU 空出时直接按优先级启动，事后汇报。

**Why:** 即使时间不够，至少有 3 sizes × 2 dosages 的 dose-response 数据足以支撑 paper core claim。

- **3B**: 必须 batch_size=1, grad_accum=16

## exp_005 γ bias 诊断结论 (2026-05-14)
- **两个诊断实验均确认 γ bias 严重**：

# Memory — contamcal-irt-calibration

## Phase 3 GPU 调度优先级 (Director 2026-05-14)
**原则：每个 model size 先跑两端极值 (d005, d100)，再填 d025/d050。**
优先级从高到低：
1. 1.5B d005 + d100 — GPU 0/5 完成 0.5B SFT 后立即接上
2. 3B d005 + d100 — 等有 GPU 空出
3. 0.5B d025 + d050 — eval GPU (1/2/4) 完成后可用
4. 1.5B d025 + d050 — 填充 dose-response 曲线
5. 3B d025 + d050 — 最后填充

**免审批：** GPU 空出时直接按优先级启动，事后汇报。

**Why:** 即使时间不够，至少有 3 sizes × 2 dosages 的 dose-response 数据足以支撑 paper core claim。

## SFT 训练参数经验 (2026-05-14)
- 6 个 0% baseline 全部成功（0.5B/1.5B/3B × s42/s123）
- 训练时长：0.5B ~53min, 1.5B ~101min, 3B ~214min (单 4090D)
- LoRA r=16 alpha=32, 1 epoch
- **0.5B**: batch_size=4, grad_accum=4 可用
- **1.5B**: 必须 batch_size=1, grad_accum=16（batch_size=2 在 24GB 4090D 上 OOM，exp_001_sft_d100_15B 事故教训）
- **3B**: 必须 batch_size=1, grad_accum=16
- --gpu 参数必须匹配物理 GPU 编号（v1/v2 OOM 教训：--gpu 0 导致 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES 覆盖）

## Dosage 数据版本 (2026-05-14)
- 所有 dosage 文件于 May 14 07:16 重新生成 v3（含 MMLU+ARC+GSM8K）
- 0% dosage = 纯 SlimOrca 50000 条，不含 paraphrases
- data_meta: arc=1172, gsm8k=1319, mmlu=14042, total_contam=16533
- 当前跑的 d005/d100 使用 ALL paraphrases（含 QC fail），属于 "noisy contamination" condition（D010 决策）
- D012 ablation: d100_qc_only 仅用 QC pass (7,547/16,697 = 45.2%)，脚本就绪未执行

## Eval Pipeline 能力 (2026-05-14)
- 4 benchmarks: MMLU, GSM8K, ARC, HumanEval ✅
- Item-level 输出: `per_item` in `eval_results.json` + `correctness_matrix.json` ✅ — IRT 分析可直接用
- 批量链式触发: `run_exp001.sh --phase all` ✅
- 单 job 链式触发: `train_and_eval.sh` (新建) ✅
- Dry-run: `--max-samples N` 参数已补 ✅
- ⚠️ Bug: `load_paraphrased_benchmark` 中 `'list' object has no attribute 'get'`，paraphrased eval 受影响，需后续修复
- 输出路径: `/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/eval_results/{Model}_d{dosage:03d}_s{seed}/`

## exp_005 γ bias 诊断结论 (2026-05-14)
- **两个诊断实验均确认 γ bias 严重**：
  - simple model: γ_mean=0.7877, rel_bias=+57.5%, CI 不覆盖真值 0.5
  - analytic ME model: γ_mean=0.7959, rel_bias=+59.2%, CI [0.556, 1.060] 不覆盖真值 0.5
  - 两者 R-hat=1.006, 0 divergences — 收敛良好但结果有偏
- **结论：bias 根因不在 measurement error 处理方式**，可能是模型 identifiability / 参数化问题（σ_e=0.1 场景下）
- exp_004 sim sweep 结果可能揭示 bias 与 N_models / signal quality 的关系
- 不阻塞 Phase 3 主实验链

## IRT Pipeline 方法论决策 (Director 2026-05-14)
- **论文结果必须用 CmdStanPy (Bayesian MCMC)**，不能用 PyTorch MLE

- Synthetic validation: 0 divergences, R-hat=1.006, ESS=1402, gamma posterior SD=0.137

- 复用 mvp_sim 已验证的 Stan model 文件 (contam_irt_4pl_simple.stan)

### exp_005_noise_prop v1 — Stan bug 修复前

- 状态：预期失败，已修复

  - Simple model 写 CSV 时 "disk quota exceeded" → 4 chains 全部 retcode=1
  - 日志证据：`/tmp/tmpjxthbs72/` 下 CSV 写入失败，retcodes=[1,1,1,1]
- **ME model 独立问题**：Rhat=1.945（10,231 参数 vs 9,000 观测 = 严重欠识别）
- 后续诊断实验 (diag_nmodels50, diag_analytic_me) 已成功运行，确认 γ bias（见上方）
- **不需要重跑 v2**：根因已明确，D013 决策弃用 ME model，D014 限定 γ 适用条件

- 使用 `contam_irt_4pl_sweep.stan`（独立于 _me/_simple，c/d 用 Beta prior 约束）

  - auc0.55_n50：10/10 ✅ 全部成功
  - auc0.55_n100：6/10 ✅，seed 6 卡在 warmup（chain 1 到 iteration 200/500 后 7h 无输出）
  - auc0.8_n50：1/10（pilot run）
  - 剩余 9 条件未跑
- **卡住原因**：max_depth=10（CmdStan 默认值，sweep 脚本未设 12）+ n_models=100 参数量大（1301 params）
  - 每次 gradient evaluation 25ms，max_treedepth 时每 iteration ~26s
  - Seed 6 初始化不佳，warmup 极其缓慢
